cardOverview.overviewText: The Tata Card Select is a premium co-branded card from Tata and SBI, offering up to 5% value back on Tata outlets, 3X rewards on dining and groceries, and 8 complimentary domestic lounge visits yearly. With a ₹2,999 annual fee, it includes ₹3,000 welcome and renewal vouchers on high spends best suited for frequent Tata shoppers seeking lifestyle perks.
